NIMBUSCLOUD DATA SOLUTIONS
PRIVACY AND DATA HANDLING POLICY
Last Updated: February 2026

1. OVERVIEW
This policy describes how NimbusCloud Data Solutions ("NimbusCloud") collects, stores, and processes data on behalf of its business clients and their customers.

2. DATA STORAGE PRACTICES
Customer data is stored on NimbusCloud's distributed server infrastructure. Data may be temporarily cached in unencrypted form during processing to optimize system performance, before being moved to long-term storage. NimbusCloud reviews its security practices periodically and updates them as needed.

3. ACCESS TO DATA
NimbusCloud employees and contracted personnel may access customer data as needed to perform support, maintenance, and analytics functions. Access is not restricted to a specific list of authorized individuals, as the size of our support team varies based on business needs.

4. INCIDENT RESPONSE
In the event of a security incident involving customer data, NimbusCloud will notify affected business clients within 30 days of confirming the incident, in line with industry best practices.

5. CUSTOMER COMPLAINTS
NimbusCloud may respond directly to end-customer inquiries or complaints received through its support channels in order to provide a timely resolution, and will share a summary with the business client afterward.

6. THIRD-PARTY SERVICE PROVIDERS
NimbusCloud works with a number of third-party infrastructure and analytics providers to deliver its services. These providers may have access to customer data as part of standard service delivery.

7. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
NimbusCloud may update this policy at any time. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
